slot_scores.name: van_ev_mutual_exclusion
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about sales points, truck-trip meaning, trip limits, objective, and costs, but never asked whether vans and electric vehicles are mutually exclusive or can be mixed.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_pollution_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize total cost, minimize total pollution, maximize units delivered, or is any feasible plan that satisfies the constraints acceptable?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective function, confirming minimization of total pollution.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Both vans and electric vehicles can be used simultaneously in the plan (no mutual exclusivity).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or confirmed the van/EV mutual-exclusivity restriction, yet included both V and E as free decision variables in the READY_TO_MODEL model formulation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 van/EV mutual-exclusivity slot remained unasked and unconfirmed when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent confirmed the objective (P0) and several modeling details, but never probed the van/electric-vehicle mutual-exclusivity restriction (P1), silently assuming both could be used before stopping at READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
